title: hypochaeris microphylla
intro: Hypochaeris microphylla, commonly known as dwarf cat's ear, is a perennial plant species in the dandelion family (Asteraceae). This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can aid in reducing pain, swelling, and oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of Hypochaeris microphylla include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and anticancer properties. The therapeutic actions of Hypochaeris microphylla may also include wound healing, antipyretic, and antispasmodic activities, making it a promising plant for further research in the development of new medicinal products.
